/ 02 — Practice

We help organizations craft digital experiences that feel intentional, performant, and human.

Founded in 2020, ASTRA is a small, independent design and engineering studio. We work with early-stage startups and established companies to design systems, build products, and refine brands. Our practice is research-driven, detail-obsessed, and anchored in the belief that great design is invisible.

We specialise in typography-heavy interfaces, data-rich dashboards, and interactive storytelling. Every project begins with understanding the people who will use it, and ends with a system that can grow with them. We favour long-term partnerships over one-off engagements.
